smart.name: Smart
smart.blurb: Plays like the Hard computer opponent: KOs, priority to finish, safe setup, recovery, hazards, switching out of bad matchups and Tera. It reads the other side only as it has been revealed.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.blurb: Always the move with the highest expected damage (average roll × accuracy) on the foe. Never switches by choice, never Terastallizes.

random.name: Random
random.blurb: Any legal move, at random (it attacks 85% of the time and otherwise may switch). A baseline: how much does skill matter here?

scripted.name: Scripted
scripted.blurb: Each Pokémon uses the moves you list, in order: one move means always that move. Never switches by choice.

run.label: Run
run.about: Every battle is a real one on Pokémon Showdown's simulator, played right here in your browser{workers, plural, =0 {} one { on {workers} worker} other { on {workers} workers}}. Each battle's randomness comes from the run's seed, so the same seed and setup always give the same result. Battles still going at turn 300 count as draws.
